overview: This paper proposes SVG, a latent diffusion model that replaces VAE with a semantically structured feature space built from frozen DINOv3 and a lightweight residual encoder, enabling accelerated diffusion training, few-step high-fidelity generation, and task-general representation learning.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Handles the loading of image datasets, applying random resizing, cropping, and normalization tailored for both the self-supervised vision foundation model encoder and the autoencoder/diffusion training pipelines.

modules.name: SVG Autoencoder Architecture
modules.description: Implements the dual-branch encoder architecture combining a frozen self-supervised vision foundation model with a lightweight Residual Encoder, alongside the SVG Decoder that maps the concatenated features back to pixel space.

modules.name: Feature Distribution Alignment
modules.description: Implements the statistical alignment mechanism that normalizes the residual encoder outputs to match the batch statistics of the frozen foundation model features, preserving semantic discriminability in the concatenated latent space.

modules.name: Autoencoder Training Workflow
modules.description: Manages the first-stage training loop for the SVG Autoencoder, coordinating the reconstruction loss computation, optimizer steps, and the freezing of the base encoder parameters while updating the residual branch and decoder.

modules.name: Diffusion Transformer Architecture
modules.description: Implements the scalable Transformer backbone adapted for the high-dimensional SVG feature space, including input patch embedding projection and Query-Key normalization for training stability.

modules.name: Flow Matching and ODE Framework
modules.description: Encapsulates the mathematical formulations for flow-based generative modeling, defining the interpolation trajectories, velocity prediction targets, and per-channel feature normalization required for the diffusion process.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the second-stage training loop for the diffusion transformer, incorporating classifier-free guidance conditioning, mixed-precision training, and learning rate scheduling strategies.

modules.name: Sampling and Inference Engine
modules.description: Implements the ODE solvers for trajectory inversion and generation, specifically supporting few-step sampling mechanisms and the zero-initialization trick for improved classifier-free guidance inference.

modules.name: Reconstruction and Generation Evaluation
modules.description: Calculates core image quality and similarity metrics, including reconstruction FID, generation FID, Inception Score, PSNR, LPIPS, and SSIM to assess both autoencoder fidelity and generative quality.

modules.name: Downstream Perception Evaluation
modules.description: Builds lightweight task-specific decoders and fine-tuning scripts to evaluate the frozen SVG encoder's transferability on image classification, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation benchmarks.

modules.name: Feature Space Visualization and Analysis
modules.description: Generates t-SNE and PCA visualizations of intermediate features to analyze and compare the semantic discriminability and structural clarity of the SVG space versus traditional VAE latent spaces.

modules.name: Latent Editing and Interpolation Tools
modules.description: Provides utilities for exploring the latent space geometry, including linear and spherical linear interpolation between noise vectors, and inversion-based pipelines for zero-shot class-conditioned image editing.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Management
modules.description: Manages hyperparameter configurations for different model scales, handles distributed training setup, checkpoint saving/loading, and logging integration for seamless experiment tracking and reproducibility.
